onMiss: Read the flagged slices and the evidence in ~/Documents/Github/auto-sns-agent/.cache/duties/dm-extension/latest (autopair.log, e2e.log, each evidence.json and the screenshots), and name the cause in one line. Each miss gets one fix job in this chat (chrome extension, 39ca7bbb-37a8-47e5-a06a-d6cea515b3cc) unless one is live: start it with rlm.create_session, or steer the live one. The fix job works in the us-metal02 checkout on dev/sieun, commits with scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs, and proves the fix with this duty's next run. An e2e_part slice is the extension (apps/dm-extension/src), its server routes (apps/search/src/routes/api/dm/extension, convex/search/dmDevices.ts and dmOutreach.ts) or the Connections and Inbox pages; read which part failed first. A maybe_sent, send_restricted or unknown_username slice names its rows: find why the extension or the server settled them that way. A source_error slice is the measure itself (a jar the prod crawler no longer holds, an ssh or Convex CLI failure, a clean world that did not come up, a rig bug): fix this precheck or the rig. A slow_exit slice means a rig's Instagram page or send wait stopped on the account's residential exit (a stall after one reload, or still loading at the ceiling), not on the extension: read the exit and bytes it names and the accounts slice, measure that exit first as owner rule c127 says (our own connections on it, other lanes, the box), and when the exit itself is slow have the crawler renew that account's exit; an e2e_part slice that names a slow exit is that same cause. An instagram_refused slice means Instagram sent the account to a login page, a challenge or a checkpoint, answered an HTTP error, or answered send_restricted: pick another active test account as below. A sender_daily_limit slice means the sender's own row in the run's fresh org had fewer than 3 sends left under its daily limit, which a fresh org's row never has unless the server started counting one Instagram account across workspaces: read convex/search/dmDevices.ts syncAccounts and dmOutreach.ts sentTodayOf, and until that is fixed set SENDER to the other active test sender, gimnayeon1396. An account the crawler parked or whose jar went invalid is not ours to sign in again: a password sign-in needs the metal box owner's ok in the Crawler VP chat, so pick another active test account in SENDER or REPLIER instead; the precheck reads each handle from whichever crawler world, prod or staging, has its row active. Test DMs go only between the crawler's own test accounts; never DM a real person and never get around an Instagram checkpoint. Prod changes ship in the release the release owner walks with the owner (c154). All on target: end the turn with no message.
